component.name: NuPrint Slint
component.summary: Print to small Bluetooth thermal printers

description.p: NuPrint prints notes, pictures and PDF pages directly to supported Bluetooth LE thermal printers, with an exact preview of the paper and a print queue that survives restarts.
NuPrint Slint is the same app drawn natively with Slint instead of in a web view. It is newer and less tested than NuPrint, and keeps its own printers and queue.
The first supported printer is the ZEITEL lowercase SC03h. Printers whose settings match it are offered as experimental.
